scan_metadata.paper_name: Ji et al. (2025), Ecology Letters, doi:10.1111/ele.70302
scan_metadata.explanation: Exactly four approved names, one quickstart owning module. Supporting APIs/tests/data are verification references, not additional execution owners. Discovery does not establish runtime/Cloud feasibility.

tutorials.title: occJSDM: quickstart
tutorials.description: Native RDS quickstart, fitting, diagnostics and baseline occupancy
tutorials.reason_for_include_or_exclude: Single owner of approved four operations

suggested_tools.task: Check an occJSDM-ready RDS and covariate choices before fitting.
suggested_tools.primary_input: data_path plus explicit occupancy/collection covariate-name lists
suggested_tools.outputs: inferred model, structural dimensions and replication, missingness counts, traits availability/alignment, actionable issues and eligibility; no raw observation values
suggested_tools.description: Check an occJSDM-ready RDS and covariate choices before fitting.

suggested_tools.source_section: Fit the model (adapt spatial example by leaving spatCovariates empty)
suggested_tools.task: Fit a supported nonspatial model and save a native result.
suggested_tools.primary_input: data_path, explicit seed, FitOptions with native covariate names, threshold, n_factors and MCMC settings
suggested_tools.outputs: fit_id, inferred model, settings/warnings and hashed fit.rds plus manifest
suggested_tools.description: Fit a supported nonspatial model and save a native result.

suggested_tools.task: Inspect convergence for selected occupancy/detection coefficients.
suggested_tools.primary_input: server-owned fit_id and max_rows default 20, capped at 20
suggested_tools.outputs: bounded table, flagged/unavailable counts, complete diagnostics CSV and warning metadata
suggested_tools.description: Inspect convergence for selected occupancy/detection coefficients.

suggested_tools.source_section: Look at the results; plotOccupancyRates delegates to returnOccupancyRates
suggested_tools.task: Summarise baseline occupancy draws and retain convergence qualifications.
suggested_tools.primary_input: server-owned fit_id and max_rows default 20, capped at 20
suggested_tools.outputs: bounded per-species baseline occupancy mean/median/95% interval, diagnostic counts/warnings, full summary CSV
suggested_tools.description: Summarise baseline occupancy draws and retain convergence qualifications.
